name: D12 prospective episode/configuration-blocked partitions
status: frozen before any D12 model fitting
purpose: separate interpolation from generalization to unseen episodes and reset configurations without task, failure, or alarm labels

episode_axis.selection: first nine episode IDs under ascending SHA-256(d12-split:1201:<episode_id>)

configuration_axis.selection: two pre-existing reset-seed families reserved in full

folds.fit: episode not reserved AND reset seed not reserved
folds.episode_validation: episode reserved AND reset seed not reserved
folds.configuration_validation: episode not reserved AND reset seed reserved
folds.joint_validation: episode reserved AND reset seed reserved

selection_labels: generic interaction stratum and source identity only; no task, failure, alarm, or model-error labels

usage.episode_validation: primary architecture comparison for episode transfer
usage.configuration_validation: primary architecture comparison for reset/configuration transfer
usage.joint_validation: small stress-test diagnostic; report uncertainty and never tune on it

restrictions.no_claim_of_truly_novel_environment_fami: all partitions derive from the existing TRAIN trace corpus
